question: What will be the day of the week on 02 February 3015?
solution:

⇒ 0 + 3 + 17

⇒ 20 odd days.

And, till 02 February

⇒ 31(Jan) + 01(Feb) = 33 odd days.

Total odd days → 20 + 33 = 53 days = 53/7 = 7 week and 4 odd days.

→ 4 represents Thursday.

So, 02 February 3015 will be **Thursday**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
